answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can enforce Sybil resistance through a cryptographic Proof-of-Stake mechanism anchored by a decentralized hardware trust trellis. Validators must lock up scarce collateral tokens—metaphorically valued akin to staking rare quartz or immutable marble—to participate in consensus and transaction validation. To execute a Sybil attack, a malicious actor faces the prohibitive economic cost of acquiring vast amounts of capital to provision distinct, cryptographically verified validator nodes, rendering mass identity spoofing mathematically and financially unviable.
